data: Is the value of the orange line higher than the value of the blue line for the beam width of 128 in the TH plot?

The question asks whether the value of the orange line is higher than the value of the blue line for the beam width of 128 in the TH plot. From the caption, we know that the orange line represents CTC and the blue line represents CCTC. In the TH plot, the orange line (CTC) is above the blue line (CCTC) at the beam width of 128. Therefore, the value of the orange line is indeed higher than the value of the blue line for this condition.
